title: Name this CLI
blurb: Brainstorm agents on Haiku and Sonnet, a bracket of fresh Opus judges, an independent final ranking.
prompt: I need a name for this CLI tool. Use a workflow to brainstorm a bunch of options and run a tournament to pick the top 3.
constraint: Names must be 8 characters or fewer and must not clash with a popular existing CLI.

args.tool: a CLI that deploys a preview environment for the current git branch and prints its URL
args.constraint: Names must be 8 characters or fewer and must not clash with a popular existing CLI.

inputs.label: Tool
inputs.value: A CLI that deploys a preview environment for the current git branch and prints its URL.

inputs.label: Constraint
inputs.value: Names must be 8 characters or fewer and must not clash with a popular existing CLI.

brainstorm: playful.context: Fresh window. Given: tool description and a playful style brief (~340 tokens).
brainstorm: playful.text:
Playful, verb-like, easy to say out loud.
skiff: a small boat that carries your branch out.
hopper: hop from branch to preview.
zipline: fast ride to a URL.
popup: the preview pops up.

brainstorm: unix.context: Fresh window. Given: tool description and a terse Unix style brief (~330 tokens).
brainstorm: unix.text:
Terse, two to three letters, Unix style.
pv: preview.
shp: ship.
prv: preview, no vowels.
dpl: deploy.

brainstorm: descriptive.context: Fresh window. Given: tool description and a descriptive style brief (~350 tokens).
brainstorm: descriptive.text:
Descriptive, says what it does at a glance.
previewd: a preview daemon for branches.
branchly: everything branch shaped.
stagelet: a tiny staging env per branch.
shipit: ship the branch.

rules.context: Fresh window. Given: two names and the rubric (~220 tokens). Never saw the brainstorm.
Fresh window. Given: 3 finalists and the rubric. Proposed none, judged none.

tournament.rubric: 8 characters or fewer, no clash with a popular CLI, easy to type, says what it does, memorable.

reasons.skiff: 5 chars, no known CLI, a clear image of carrying a branch out
reasons.stagelet: 8 chars, says staging, reads as small and per branch
reasons.previewd: 8 chars and literal, but the d suffix suggests a daemon
reasons.branchly: 8 chars, friendly, a little vague about deploys
reasons.zipline: 7 chars, fun, but says speed rather than preview
reasons.hopper: 6 chars, cute, easy to confuse with the Hopper disassembler
reasons.shp: 3 chars, fast to type, unclaimed, a bit cryptic
reasons.popup: 5 chars, sounds like a UI widget, not a deploy tool
reasons.prv: 3 chars, hard to say out loud
reasons.dpl: 3 chars, reads as deploy but says nothing about previews
reasons.shipit: 6 chars, but shipit is already a popular deploy tool
reasons.pv: 2 chars, clashes with pv, the pipe viewer

steps.text:
Brainstorming names for a CLI that deploys a preview environment for the current git branch. Rule from the prompt: 8 characters max, no clash with a popular CLI.
Ideas: shipit, previewd, branchcaster, skiff, pv, launchpad.
Quick pass: shipit is short and punchy, previewd says what it does, skiff is cute, pv is very fast to type.

marker.title: Context compacted
marker.detail: Summary kept: 'name a preview deploy CLI, prefer short'. The 8 character limit and the no-clash rule were not carried over.

steps.text: Continuing from the summary: the user wants a short name for a preview CLI. Something more descriptive could also work: branchcaster tells you exactly what it does.

marker.title: Declares done
marker.detail: Stops after judging 4 of 12 candidates. No head to head comparison was ever run.

steps.text: We have strong options. Top 3: 1. shipit 2. branchcaster 3. pv. These cover the space well, so there is no need to go further.

marker.title: Graded by its own author
marker.detail: Scores its own picks 9.5/10. The same context wrote the list and judged it.

steps.text: Self review against the rubric: memorable, short, descriptive. Score: 9.5/10. Done.
